host_sampler.scope: Fresh rollout slice: input preparation, controller, private service and all its descendants; host file includes shmem, not guest Cached.

analysis.observed: The guest request was refused after successful relay readiness and upload of the relay environment. The service log identifies the guest host-interaction address as 10.211.0.1.
analysis.source_fact: global_host_iptables_commands accepts established replies then rejects new guest-to-host INPUT traffic; assigning a local address routes guest requests to INPUT, not FORWARD.
analysis.interpretation: Host INPUT rejection is the leading explanation; the previous offline review checked namespace egress CIDRs but omitted host INPUT.
analysis.missing_direct_evidence: The matching 10.211 INPUT rule counter was not saved during the failed request. After service cleanup its rule was removed, so an actual counter hit is not verified.

next_requirement: Confirm a temporary, exact guest source / relay destination / TCP port INPUT exception and deletion of only the retained failed volume before another live run; preserve default private egress denies and every other rule.
